source: Exact copied public recipe, Gatherer and Miner evidence; explicit pinned admission required.

quests.name: An ebony seam's account
quests.text: The Smith needs an ebony and silver parcel for the next furnace run, with a spare pick for the mine. Bring the complete parcel.

difficulty.note: Four Master-gated Ebony Ore, four Advanced Silver Ore and one public spare pick; no mine or yield is changed.

quests.name: An outfitter's last reserve
quests.text: The Woodworker needs a master fishing pole and a full bundle of ebony arrows for an outfitter's reserve. Bring both parts.

difficulty.note: One Master pole batch and one Master arrow batch; the arrows make24 per batch.

quests.name: Winter vestments for a caravan
quests.text: The Tailor needs three sets of ragged robes and three snowy-sabre fur cloaks for a winter caravan. This is a complete outfitting order.

difficulty.note: Six production batches, including three Expert fur cloaks. This is Master logistical work, not a new Master clothing recipe or an enchanting claim.

quests.name: A ward tutor's demonstration stock
quests.text: The Enchanter needs two ebony shields and two sets of ragged robes for an Alteration tutor's demonstration stock. No particular enchantment is required.

difficulty.note: Two Master shield batches, with two additional robe batches. These are public equipment supplies, not a promise of blank or enchanted gear.

quests.name: A mammoth supper for the hall
quests.text: The Cook needs two mammoth steaks and two mammoth stews for a supper in the hall. Bring both courses together.

difficulty.note: Both dishes have Master supply provenance; recipe conditions still apply to whoever cooks them.

quests.name: Remedies for the ash-road expedition
quests.text: The Alchemist needs two physicker remedies and four ash creep clusters for an expedition's supplies. Bring the finished remedies and the separate reagents.

difficulty.note: Master-gated Ash Creep Cluster and two Advanced remedies. No effect is claimed for brewing the supplied reagents.

quests.name: A field medic's travelling case
quests.text: The Alchemist needs two physicker remedies and four nirnroots for a travelling case. Bring both parts as one delivery.

difficulty.note: Expert-gated Nirnroot with two Advanced remedy batches; no particular plant placement or harvest event is promised.

quests.name: Clothes for the commission rack

difficulty.note: Two public Novice wearable batches with measured Novice inputs; the source does not promise unenchanted blanks.
